test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure from the given options would replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66767caa29b3c29682f7f08139d9021390d8dc0040fbd42fd958db1686a6d36b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

All 4 corner symbols are shifting in clockwise direction.

Middle symbols are interchanging their position.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

Top-left, and bottom-right elements are interchanging their position.

Top-right, bottom-left and middle 2 elements are shifting in an anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1753bdcefd9bf765fc55ba00cd5803268fb721ab3616929f8e75822ff444a861.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
